list-generator.use: Paste one item per line, pick an output format (Numbered, Bulleted, Comma Separated or Pipe Separated) and press Convert.

add-text-to-lines.use: Paste your lines, type the prefix or suffix, then add it at the beginning or at the end of every line.

convert-case.use: Paste text, choose a case (UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case or CONSTANT_CASE) and press Convert.

fill: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

count-duplicates.use: Paste a list, one item per line, and press Analyze to see every value with the number of times it occurs.

apple

remove-duplicate-lines.use: Paste a list and press Remove Duplicates; “Case sensitive” and “Preserve original order” are on by default and can be turned off.

remove-line-breaks.use: Paste text, choose what replaces each line break (Space, Nothing or a Custom string) and press Remove Line Breaks.

remove-lines-containing.use: Paste text, list words or phrases separated by commas and press Remove Lines; lines containing any of them are dropped and counted.

fill:
INFO server started
DEBUG cache miss
INFO request served
DEBUG retry scheduled

sort-text.use: Paste lines, pick a sort method (A → Z, Z → A, shortest or longest first, numeric, reverse, random), optionally trim, remove empty lines or duplicates, and press Sort Lines.

text-counter.use: Type or paste text: characters, words, sentences, paragraphs, reading and speaking time and top keywords update as you write.

fill: Tools Collection runs entirely in your browser. Nothing you type is ever uploaded, logged or stored on a server. Close the tab and it is gone.

slug-generator.use: Type a title: you get a URL-safe slug, with accents transliterated and the separator and maximum length you choose.

fill: Ça marche! 54 tools for Developers & Admins

lorem-ipsum-generator.use: Choose paragraphs, sentences or words and how many, then press Generate for placeholder text.

password-generator.use: Set the length, how many and the character sets, then press Generate Password; ambiguous characters are left out by default and Simple mode is available.

passphrase-generator.use: Choose the words per passphrase, how many and the separator, then press Generate Passphrases.

pin-generator.use: Pick the PIN length and how many you need; duplicates can be avoided.

username-generator.use: Pick a style and press Generate Usernames for handles you can use for test accounts or new sign-ups.

uuid-generator.use: UUID v4, time-ordered UUID v7 and ULID are ready on load; press Generate for new ones or Generate 10 for a batch.

random-string-generator.use: Set the length, the count and the character set (alphanumeric, hex, Base64URL…) and press Generate Strings.

api-key-generator.use: Set a prefix such as sk_live_, the length of the random part and the character set, then generate keys.

qr-code.use: Type a URL or any text, pick a size and press Generate QR Code; you can also upload a picture to read a QR code, where the browser supports it.

bittorrent-magnet-link-generator.use: Paste a 40-character hex (or 32-character Base32) info hash, optionally a name and trackers: you get a magnet link.

markdown-to-html.use: Type Markdown and the HTML and a live preview update as you write; save it with Download HTML or Download full document.

email-extractor.use: Paste any text — a mail thread, a log, a web page — and press Extract Emails for a clean list of addresses.

fill: Write to ada@example.com or ops@example.org; cc linus@example.net and ada@example.com again.

domain-extractor.use: Paste URLs, one per line, and press Extract Domains; subdomains can be kept or folded into the main domain.

diff-checker.use: Paste the original and the modified text side by side and press Compare Texts to see added and removed lines.

regex-tester.use: Write a pattern as /pattern/flags, paste test text and press Test Regex: every match and capture group is listed.

fill: Contact ada@example.com or linus@kernel.org for access.

password-strength.use: Type a password to see a score out of 8, which checks it passes and suggestions; the check runs in your browser.

hash-generator.use: Type text and press Generate Hash for its SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 digests.

pem-inspector.use: Paste a PEM certificate and press Extract Information for its SHA-256 fingerprint, DER size and the first DER bytes in hex.

rclone-password.use: Paste a password obscured by rclone (from rclone.conf) and press Reveal Password to recover the clear text.

jwt-secret-generator.use: Choose the secret size (16–64 bytes), how many, and Base64URL or Hex, then press Generate JWT Secrets.

hmac-key-generator.use: Choose the key size (16–64 bytes), how many and Base64URL, Base64 or Hex, then press Generate HMAC Keys.

aes-key-generator.use: Choose AES-128, 192 or 256 and press Generate AES Key; the key is shown in hex and Base64.

salt-generator.use: Choose the salt size (8–32 bytes), how many and Base64URL, Base64 or Hex, then press Generate Salts.

recovery-code-generator.use: Set the number of codes, characters per code and group size, then press Generate Recovery Codes and copy the list.

base64.use: Type text and press Encode Base64, or paste Base64 and press Decode Base64.

url-encoder.use: Paste a URL or a value and encode or decode it; Encode Component also escapes characters such as / ? & =.

html-entity.use: Paste text and Encode it into HTML entities (only & < > " ' or every non-ASCII character), or Decode entities back.

number-base-converter.use: Type a number in any field — decimal, hexadecimal, binary or octal — and the others follow.

data-size-converter.use: Type a size, pick its unit and press Convert Size to see it in bits, bytes, KB–TB and KiB–TiB (all base 1024).

time-convert.use: Type a duration, pick its unit and press Convert Time to see it in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days and HH:MM:SS.

timestamp-converter.use: Paste a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds and press Convert, or take the current time.

heic-to-jpg.use: Drop iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos and download them as JPG; the conversion runs on your device and EXIF metadata is not kept.

json-formatter.use: Paste JSON, choose the indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces, Tab or Compact) and press Format JSON; invalid JSON is flagged.

xml-beautifier.use: Paste XML, choose the indentation and press Format XML.

yaml-formatter.use: Paste YAML or JSON, choose an action (Format, Minify, YAML to JSON, JSON to YAML) and the indentation, then press Execute.

toml-formatter.use: Paste TOML or JSON, choose an action (Format, Minify, TOML to JSON, JSON to TOML) and the indentation, then press Execute.

csv-viewer.use: Paste CSV data to see it as a table you can sort by clicking a column; the delimiter is detected and Export as JSON downloads it.

jwt-decoder.use: Paste a JWT to see its decoded header and payload and whether it is still valid or expired; the signature is not verified.

cron-expression.use: Build a schedule with the presets or type a cron expression: you get a plain-English summary and the next run times.

docker-run-to-compose.use: Paste a docker run command and press Convert to Compose for the equivalent docker-compose.yml, or go the other way.

color-picker.use: Pick a colour or type HEX, RGB or HSL and press Convert Color to get it in every notation.

date-interval.use: Pick a start and an end date: total days, weeks, working days and a years/months/days breakdown.

emoji-shortcode.use: Type text and press Shortcode → Emoji to turn :shortcodes: into emoji, or Emoji → Shortcode to go back.

reg2gpo.use: Paste or upload a .reg export, name the collection and press Generate GPO XML for Group Policy Preferences.
